subject: Post-pilot outcomes and quick quote / 15m sync
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lopez <emma.lopez@apexretail.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-pilot outcomes & quick quote / 15m sync

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for running the pilot with us last month. Quick summary of the concrete outcomes we observed during the two-week scoped test against your "recommendation-serving" workload: 

• End-to-end P95 latency improved from ~390ms (baseline hosted endpoint) to ~120ms on Redwood Dedicated (P95 measured across production-like requests).
• Per-inference token cost decreased ~2.8x after enabling int8 quantization + automatic batching and prefix KV caching.
• Throughput (concurrent inference throughput) scaled ~3.5x on the dedicated pool without impacting tail latency.
• KV cache hit rate averaged 42% on repeat requests, contributing ~27% of the cost savings.

I've attached a one-pager and the raw metric snapshot for your records (redwood-postpoc-onepager.pdf, apex-metrics-snapshot.csv). There's also a short NDA excerpt we referenced around attribution (nda-excerpt.pdf).

Would you be open to two things?
1) A one- or two-sentence public quote we can use in a short customer spotlight (we'll share the draft for approval). Example: “Redwood cut inference latency by X and reduced cost by Y, enabling…" — but feel free to phrase however you'd like.
2) A 15-minute sync this week to capture a very quick recorded soundbite (30s) and confirm attribution/logo use.

Suggested times (PT): Wed 10/28 11:00am, Thu 10/29 9:00am — but happy to align with your calendar. If you prefer, approving a short written blurb by reply works just as well.

Thanks again — excited by what we were able to show and want to make this low-friction for your team.

Best,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood-postpoc-onepager.pdf (1pg), apex-metrics-snapshot.csv (metrics export), nda-excerpt.pdf (attribution clause)

I can do 15 minutes on Wed 10/28 at 11:00am PT — that works for me. If you want to send a two-line suggested quote ahead of time, I'll sign off quickly.
